t: OB21 Professional Builders Universal Silicone is a high-performance, clear sealant designed for robust and reliable sealing across various construction applications. This solvent-free, low modulus silicone is ideal for trade professionals working on expansion joints in concrete and brickwork, or for sealing in kitchens and bathrooms. It offers superior adhesion to most substrates without primer, ensuring a strong bond. The silicone is water, UV, and weather-resistant, providing long-lasting durability. Its non-corrosive properties make it safe for use with metals, making it a versatile choice for many projects.
b: Suitable for Use on Most Building Substrates, Glazing, Kitchens, Bathrooms & Industrial Applications
Provides Strong Adhesion to Many Substrates
